quests.title: The Isle Bites Back
quests.description: Elder Kang'ari doesn't waste words on the beasts of Echo Isles - raptors, panthers, serpents thick enough in the interior that the camp's own people can't gather safely past the tree line. Before anything else gets sorted out on this island, the immediate danger needs thinning. It's not glamorous work. It's necessary work.
quests.accept_text: Ten of them, any mix - raptor, panther, serpent, the interior's thick with all three right now. Nothing personal in this one. Just clearing ground.
quests.turn_in_text: Good. Da tree line's quieter now. Not safe - dis island hasn't been safe in longer than you'd guess - but quieter. Dat's worth something.

quests.title: Building Something Permanent
quests.description: Rask'jin is trying to turn a temporary landing spot into an actual camp, and that means materials - good coral for binding, shell for tools, sturdy jungle wood, the kind of unglamorous groundwork nobody writes songs about. He's matter-of-fact about it: a real camp means the Darkspear who wash up here have somewhere to land besides open sand.
quests.accept_text: Da reef coral you want is da tough kind, not da pretty kind - deep red, grows near where da current's strongest. Bring me six pieces and dis camp gets a real palisade instead of a prayer.
quests.turn_in_text: Dis is good stock, mon. Palisade's going up by week's end. You didn't have to help build somethin' dat's not really your home. Means somethin' dat you did anyway.

quests.title: Eyes on the Cultists
quests.description: Vessa Palewind watches the tree line for a living, and she's seen enough movement toward the eastern camps to want real eyes on the ground before anyone commits to a fight. The Troll Camps aren't just hostile territory - they're Darkspear territory, held now by Zalazane's cultists, which makes every report back from there personal in a way Vessa doesn't bother hiding.
quests.accept_text: Don't engage. I mean dat - just get eyes on da camp layout and get back here. We fight smart on dis one, not angry, no matter how angry it deserves to make you.
quests.turn_in_text: Good. Now we know what we're walkin' into. Dat's worth more dan you'd think - most people who die out dere die because dey walked in blind.

quests.title: The Camps Answer For It
quests.description: With Vessa's scouting report in hand, Elder Kang'ari is ready to send fighters into the Troll Camps for real. Voodoo trolls, hex trolls, Zalazane's berserkers and headhunters - all of them Darkspear once, all of them lost to whatever hold Zalazane has over them now. Kang'ari doesn't ask you to feel good about this fight. He asks you to finish it.
quests.accept_text: Twelve of dem. I won't lie to you about what dat means - every one of dem used to be someone's kin, someone's name before Zalazane took it. Do it anyway. Dey're not comin' back from what he did to dem.
quests.turn_in_text: It's done. I felt every one of dose losses, even da ones dat happened years before you ever set foot on dis island. Da camps are quiet now. Zalazane still has da temple and his own hollow. Dat's where dis really ends.

quests.title: What Zalazane Took
quests.description: Before the final push, Kang'ari wants something recovered, not destroyed - hexed Darkspear totems scattered through what's left of the camps, fetishes twisted by Zalazane's magic but not beyond recognizing. He wants to SEE them, study what was done, maybe find a way to undo some of it for the trolls still lost out there. This isn't about killing anything else. It's about understanding what happened here.
quests.accept_text: Five totems. Just bring dem to me, don't touch da magic still on dem if you can help it - I've seen what dat kind of hex does to someone who handles it careless.
quests.turn_in_text: Dis... dis tells me more dan I expected. Da hex isn't as permanent as I feared. Dere may be a way back for some of dem, someday. Not today. But someday. Keep dat hope wherever you carry hope, whatever dat looks like for you.

quests.title: The Drowned Temple
quests.description: The Sunken Temple Grotto floods with the tide and empties with it, and something ancient has claimed the flooded chambers as its own - Tidelord Gharesh, an elemental bruiser that Kang'ari suspects Zalazane either summoned or simply failed to stop. Either way, it guards ground the Darkspear used to hold sacred, and Kang'ari wants it gone before anyone worries about reclaiming what's underneath.
quests.accept_text: It moves with da tide - stronger when da water's high, slower when it's not. Time it right and dis fight is winnable. Time it wrong and you're fightin' a flood dat hits back.
quests.turn_in_text: Da temple's quiet. Whatever dat thing was guardin', it's safe now, at least from dat. One name left, mon. Da one dat started all of dis.

unique_item_defs.name: Gharesh's Tidal Core
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: It shifts weight in your hand like it's still keeping time with a tide that isn't there anymore.
unique_item_defs.label: Off-Hand (Int)

quests.title: Zalazane
quests.description: Zalazane's Hollow is the last of it - the source, the witch doctor who turned his own kin into hexed and drowned things rather than lead them honestly. Kang'ari has waited a long time to say this name to someone capable of ending it. He doesn't dress up what this fight means to him. Zalazane didn't just attack the Darkspear. He took them, one hex at a time, and wore their loyalty like something he'd earned instead of stolen.
quests.accept_text: He's da strongest hexer I've ever seen, and I've seen a few. He'll try to turn your own party against you before he ever raises a weapon himself. Break da hex fast or don't let it land at all. Dat's da whole fight, really.
quests.turn_in_text: It's over. Zalazane is finished, and dis island belongs to da livin' again, not to whatever he was tryin' to make of it. I've carried dis a long time. I don't fully know how to put down a weight dat old, but I suspect I'll figure it out startin' today. Take what he had. You've more than earned it, and I mean dat as far more dan words.

unique_item_defs.name: Zalazane's Broken Fetish
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: The hex magic in it is dead now, snuffed out the moment he fell. It still hums faintly anyway, like habit.
unique_item_defs.label: Staff (Int)

unique_item_defs.name: Darkspear Reclamation Circlet
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Kang'ari says it belonged to a chieftain before Zalazane melted it down for parts. He had it reforged the moment word reached camp.
unique_item_defs.label: Head (Str/Sta)
